title: What enumeration proposed and the kernel kept — 118 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit and how they are bound
description:
What enumeration proposed and the kernel kept — 118 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the imagined. 118 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide). Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 1 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 6903 pair(s); the theorems fall into 1 strand(s), the largest of 118. Most binding: m9 (118).

2 · Imports. Built on: z9.lean. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 2 file(s): src/proof/imagined.lean, src/proof/z9.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 118 sealed receipts fold to 37fe0337-e772-8eb0-861c-2ee17049b0cf. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (0, 4, 2, 5, 0, 7, 5). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: energy.lean (46 observed, 27.49 expected, lift 1.67), demand2.lean (16 observed, 10.47 expected, lift 1.53), address.lean (32 observed, 22.25 expected, lift 1.44). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 15.52; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.5. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 43.5% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. the doubling orbit 1,2,4,8,7,5 is the cyclic group U(9), which is cyclic of order 6 generated by 2, with units {1,2,4,5,7,8} = φ(9); 2 and 5 are its only generators. Standard elementary number theory, in Gauss and in every abstract-algebra text. The closure statements quantify that structure. Searched 2026-09-04, term "multiplicative group of units mod 9 cyclic order 6 generated by 2"; prior art found and credited Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.
